The Chinese characters for Wesley

As a transliteration, Wesley is usually written 韦斯利 (Wéi sī lì). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

韦
Wéi
leather (a surname)
斯
sī
this (transliteration)
利
lì
sharp, benefit

Origin and meaning

With English origins, Wesley is usually read as “west meadow”.

About the name Wesley

The surname of John Wesley, founder of Methodism.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Wesley suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
